visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A hand displays small pink badges with Chibi Maruko-chan illustrations against a blurry indoor background. The camera cuts to a girl in a white shirt holding a blue fan and a red booklet inside a brightly lit exhibition hall. (2) A girl wearing a yellow hat, brown t-shirt, beige skirt, and a red school backpack walks through a gallery featuring oversized cutouts of anime characters and white walls with black line art of the series. (3) Close-up shot of a hand pressing a decorative stamp onto paper, followed by a series of cuts showing meticulously recreated scenes of Maruko's kitchen and living room with 2D character standees. (4) Inside a simulated school setting, the camera pans over a yellow shoe locker and a wall display of character portraits, then shows a classroom with small wooden desks and character cutouts standing at the front. (5) Close-up views of original hand-drawn sketches on paper with Japanese text. The scene transitions to a girl interacting with a wooden fortune drawer cabinet and then two girls standing in a colorful recreation of a traditional Japanese candy store. (6) A large mascot of Chibi Maruko-chan performs a dance routine on a stage under flashing stage lights, with a stylized Mount Fuji background. (7) Handheld shots move through a souvenir shop filled with themed mugs, water bottles, and toys. The final scene shows two girls outdoors on a city sidewalk pointing at a colorful manhole cover featuring the anime character.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) Fast-tempo, energetic J-Pop background music begins. A male narrator speaks with a high-arousal, friendly tone. Minimal ambient hum. (2) The narration continues alongside the BGM. At roughly 11 seconds, a mechanical thud or 'stamp' sound occurs as a visitor uses a decorative stamp. (3) Narrator's pitch remains consistent while describing the interior scenes. Faint female laughter and background chatter from other museum guests are audible in the distance. (4) The BGM transitions into the famous 'Odoru Pompokolin' theme song with female Japanese vocals. The audio mix becomes denser with rhythmic synth beats and clapping sounds synchronized with the mascot's dance. (5) Narrator returns for final descriptions. A subtle shift in acoustics occurs as the scene moves outdoors, with very faint urban traffic noise detectable behind the fading music.
